title: Bug Hunt 2 - Lost Scores (the sort that loses items)
body:
Goal: fix the 3 bugs in sort_scores. When it works, Run prints:

Sorted:   [10, 10, 30, 40, 50]
Original: [40, 10, 30, 10, 50]

How to hunt:

  1. Press Run and compare with the expected output. What is missing?
  2. Click Debug. Press Step over (F6) again and again. In the Variables view, watch remaining, result AND scores.
  3. Ask: when does the loop stop? Is something left behind? What happens to the second 10? Why does scores shrink too?

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Run it and compare with the expected output. Which numbers are missing? Also look at the second line. The original list should still have all 5 scores, but it does not.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Use the Thonny debugger and press Step over again and again. Watch remaining, result and scores in the Variables view. Ask: when does the loop stop? And what does remaining = scores really do to the list?

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Look at three lines. First, look at remaining = scores: do remaining and scores now share one list? Second, check the while condition: does the last item get a turn? Third, read the if smallest not in result: line and think about the two 10s.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Bug Hunt 2: Lost Scores
# sort_scores should give back EVERY score, smallest first, and leave the
# original list alone. It has 3 bugs that make scores disappear!
# Expected output when fixed:
#   Sorted:   [10, 10, 30, 40, 50]
#   Original: [40, 10, 30, 10, 50]


def sort_scores(scores):
    """Return a NEW list with the same scores from smallest to largest.
    The original list must not change."""
    remaining = scores
    result = []
    while len(remaining) > 1:
        smallest = remaining[0]
        for score in remaining:
            if score < smallest:
                smallest = score
        if smallest not in result:
            result.append(smallest)
        remaining.remove(smallest)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    scores = [40, 10, 30, 10, 50]
    print("Sorted:  ", sort_scores(scores))
    print("Original:", scores)
